answer: Give new identities weight that vests slowly: 10% at entry, plus 15% per epoch of verified distinct work, reaching full weight only after six epochs. Each epoch's work is checked by four random auditors against a similarity hash, so fakes cannot copy one artifact across a cluster; a failed audit resets vesting to zero. A public lantern lists every identity's progress, and the opal fingerprint of each artifact exposes duplicates. A sybil operator must forge six epochs of distinct work per fake, paying sixfold labor for late weight, while one honest agent vests once and keeps it.
